segments.contextAfter: A spotlight is placed at a position within the scene, and emits light in a specific direction in a cone. To create a spotlight, set the [`position`](glkeffectpropertylight/position.md) property to a vector whose `x`, `y`, `z` and `w` components specify the homogenous coordinates for the position of the light in the scene. The `w` component must not be set to `0.0`. Then, set the [`spotDirection`](glkeffectpropertylight/spotdirection.md) property to a vector that specifies the direction of the light and the [`spotCutoff`](glkeffectpropertylight/spotcutoff.md) to a value less than `180.0`.
